bio.text: Vanessa Enoch, a Democrat, is a candidate for Ohio's 8th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election.

According to Ballotpedia's profile, which draws on candidate-provided information, she was born in Cincinnati, lives in West Chester, Ohio, and works as a management and policy consultant; she has also worked as a journalist, television reporter, college professor and dean of students.

Her education includes a bachelor's degree in criminal justice from Ohio State University (1992), an MBA from Xavier University (1999) and a doctorate in public policy from Union Institute & University.
